title: De eso mejor no
desc: A subject that closes without anybody refusing
setting: Six people in the yard, beer, music, and you have just asked something that landed wrong.

steps.speaker: Julio
steps.es: (contesta corto) Sí, está caro el arroz.

options.feedback: The short answer was the whole message. In this yard that is how a no is given.

options.es: Sí, pero yo preguntaba por otra cosa.
options.en: Yes, but I was asking about something else.
options.feedback: He knows what you were asking. Repeating it makes him refuse out loud.

options.en: No, seriously, what do you all think?
options.feedback: Now four people have to find a way out of a room you have closed the door of.
You took the exit he built and used it. That is the whole skill, and nobody will ever mention it.
Safe. Somebody still has to start the next subject and it might as well be you.

options.en: Turn it down, we are talking.
options.feedback: You have just dismantled the escape route in front of everybody.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Bueno, y de lo del primo de Chino, ¿qué pasó?
steps.en: Anyway, what happened with Chino's cousin?

options.en: Yes, tell me, did he end up going?
options.feedback: You joined the new subject immediately and with interest. The old one is now gone for good.
Joined, but limply. Somebody else has to carry it now.

options.en: I will come back to the other thing in a bit.
options.feedback: Announcing that you intend to reopen it is worse than reopening it.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: (después, en el portón) De eso no se habla en grupo, vos.
steps.en: (later, at the gate) That is not talked about in a group.

options.es: Ya lo entendí. Gracias por decírmelo.
options.en: I understand now. Thank you for telling me.
options.feedback: He waited for the gate to tell you, which is a kindness, and you took it as one.
Fine. It is a shade defensive for somebody doing you a favour.

options.en: But nobody said anything to me.
options.feedback: Nobody says anything. That is the thing he is explaining to you.
